faq.q: What is in the free HSN snapshot?
faq.a: Two pages for your product code: the top importing countries, the duty Indian goods pay there, the export schemes you may claim, and a clear next step. There is no obligation.

faq.q: I have never exported. Can you help?
faq.a: Yes. We set up your IEC, GST LUT and RCMC, prepare your product for a chosen market, and stay with you until your first shipment is paid.

The snapshot is free. Services are quoted per scope, and partner fees for CAs, CHAs and freight are shared upfront. Under our Export Sales Partner model you pay a monthly retainer plus 5–10% commission on export payments actually received.

faq.q: Do you guarantee orders or payments?
faq.a: No, and you should be careful of anyone who does. We improve your odds: the right market, compliant documents, safer payment terms and direct outreach to real importers.

faq.q: Which products do you work with?
faq.a: Our focus is handicrafts, home textiles, carpets and rugs, and apparel. We assess other products by their HSN code.

faq.q: Can you help me claim RoDTEP and other schemes?
faq.a: Yes. We check eligibility for each shipment, make sure shipping bills and bank records are correct, and file claims on time.
